_description: Named reaction pattern library. Provides typical conditions for common organic reactions.

reactions.name: Suzuki coupling
reactions.description: Pd-catalyzed cross-coupling of aryl halides with boronic acids/esters.

reactions.name: Stille coupling
reactions.description: Pd-catalyzed cross-coupling of aryl halides with organotin compounds.

reactions.name: Heck reaction
reactions.description: Pd-catalyzed coupling of aryl halides with alkenes (Mizoroki-Heck).

reactions.name: Sonogashira coupling
reactions.description: Pd/Cu-catalyzed coupling of aryl halides with terminal alkynes.

reactions.name: Buchwald-Hartwig amination
reactions.description: Pd-catalyzed C-N bond formation between aryl halides and amines.

reactions.name: Knoevenagel condensation
reactions.description: Base-catalyzed condensation of aldehydes with active methylene compounds.

reactions.name: Vilsmeier-Haack formylation
reactions.description: Electrophilic formylation using POCl3/DMF reagent system.

reactions.name: Wittig reaction
reactions.description: Olefination of aldehydes/ketones via phosphonium ylides.

reactions.name: Grignard reaction
reactions.description: Formation and reaction of organomagnesium halide with electrophiles.

reactions.name: Aldol condensation
reactions.description: Base-catalyzed C-C bond formation between carbonyl compounds.

reactions.name: Negishi coupling
reactions.description: Pd-catalyzed cross-coupling with organozinc reagents.

reactions.name: Kumada coupling
reactions.description: Pd/Ni-catalyzed coupling with Grignard reagents.

reactions.name: Stille polymerization
reactions.description: Step-growth polymerization via Pd-catalyzed Stille coupling. Primary route for conjugated D-A copolymers (PM6, PTB7-Th, D18). Requires strict oxygen exclusion and degassed solvents.

reactions.name: Knoevenagel end-capping
reactions.description: Knoevenagel condensation for attaching electron-accepting IC end-groups to NFA cores (ITIC, Y6 synthesis). Pyridine or β-alanine catalyzed.

reactions.name: direct arylation polymerization
reactions.description: Atom-economical polymerization via C-H activation. Avoids organometallic monomers (no tin/boron waste). Emerging green route for conjugated polymers.

reactions.name: NBS bromination
reactions.description: Electrophilic bromination using N-bromosuccinimide. Standard method for selective bromination of thiophenes, furans, and electron-rich aromatics.

reactions.name: Miyaura borylation
reactions.description: Pd-catalyzed borylation of aryl halides with bis(pinacolato)diboron. Produces boronate esters for subsequent Suzuki coupling.

reactions.name: CuAAC click chemistry
reactions.description: Copper(I)-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition (Sharpless click). CuSO4/sodium ascorbate generates Cu(I) in situ. Forms 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazoles.

reactions.name: diazotization
reactions.description: Conversion of aromatic amines to aryl azides via diazotization with t-BuONO/TMSN3. Key step for CuAAC click chemistry substrates.

reactions.name: TBS protection
reactions.description: tert-Butyldimethylsilyl protection of alcohols/amines. TBSOTf (fast, low temp) or TBSCl/imidazole (mild). Removed by TBAF or HF.

reactions.name: BF3 Lewis acid activation
reactions.description: BF3·Et2O-mediated Lewis acid activation. Used for allylations, epoxide openings, Mannich reactions, and other electrophilic additions.

reactions.name: enol triflate formation
reactions.description: Formation of vinyl triflates from ketones via enolization (LiHMDS/LDA) followed by trapping with PhN(Tf)2 or Tf2O. Converts C=O to C-OTf for cross-coupling.

reactions.name: benzylation
reactions.description: N- or O-benzylation with benzyl bromide. Used for protecting groups, NHC precursor synthesis, and quaternization of heterocycles.
